name: Grunt Logmar
summary: At Camp Taurajo, Grunt Logmar watches the Horde's southern Barrens frontier. He tracks nearby threats and seeks aid for scouts who have gone missing.

sections.title: Duty at Camp Taurajo
sections.body: At Camp Taurajo, Grunt Logmar guards the Horde's southern frontier in the Barrens. The camp lies among the tauren, near hostile quilboar grounds and mountain passes into Stonetalon and Mulgore. Logmar watches these dangers and gathers reports from scouts. When local hostiles ambush or capture his comrades, he calls on capable Horde travelers to find and aid them.

faq.answer: At Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens, Grunt Logmar guards the settlement for the Horde. He also directs scouting and rescue efforts.

faq.q: Where can Grunt Logmar be found?
faq.answer: You can find Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo, in the southern Barrens along the road toward the Great Lift and Thousand Needles.
Logmar watches over missing Horde scouts. He sends travelers to investigate the disappearance and captivity of fellow grunt Dogran, and to recover vital supplies such as Ken'zigla's draught.

angles.text: Logmar is a frontline Horde soldier who supports the tauren in the Barrens. He relies on Horde champions to aid fallen and captured scouts.
As an orc grunt stationed far from Orgrimmar, you stand alongside the Horde's tauren allies.
